26381-uncle-sam-s-boys-as-lieutenants-or.title: Serving Old Glory as Line Officers
26381-uncle-sam-s-boys-as-lieutenants-or.creator: H. Irving Hancock
26381-uncle-sam-s-boys-as-lieutenants-or.description: A book by H. Irving Hancock. Uncle Sam's Boys shunned by neighbors. "We won't submit to such false charges." A town divided against itself. A bitter attack in the press. "The culprits face their ordeal to-day." CHAPTER V--BEFORE A COURT OF INQUIRY 62 Looks dark for the young lieutenants. Perjurers have their say. "I wouldn't believe 'em under oath." Gangsters get a jolt. The findings of the Court of Inquiry. Hal and Noll outwit the enemy. CHAPTER VI--THE CALL TO DUTY 74 All in the soldier's game.

arxiv-2201-07692.title: GroupGazer: A Tool to Compute the Gaze per Participant in Groups with integrated Calibration to Map the Gaze Online to a Screen or Beamer Projection
arxiv-2201-07692.creator: Wolfgang Fuhl, Daniel Weber, Shahram Eivazi
arxiv-2201-07692.description: Abstract In this paper we present GroupGaze. It is a tool that can be used to calculate the gaze direction and the gaze position of whole groups. GroupGazer calculates the gaze direction of every single person in the image and allows to map these gaze vectors to a projection like a projector.

arxiv-2207-04798.title: Combing a Linkage in an Annulus
arxiv-2207-04798.creator: Petr A. Golovach, Giannos Stamoulis, Dimitrios M. Thilikos
arxiv-2207-04798.description: Abstract A linkage in a graph G G of size k k is a subgraph L L of G G whose connected components are k k paths. The pattern of a linkage of size k k is the set of k k pairs formed by the endpoints of these paths.

arxiv-2305-06489.title: Intrinsically patterned two-dimensional transition metal halides
arxiv-2305-06489.creator: Feifei Xiang, Neeta Bisht, Binbin Da, Mohammed S. G. Mohammed, Christian Neiß, Andreas Görling, Sabine Maier
arxiv-2305-06489.description: Abstract Patterning and defect engineering are key methods to tune 2D materials’ properties. However, generating 2D periodic patterns of point defects in 2D materials has been elusive until now, despite the well-established methods for creating isolated point defects and defect lines.

arxiv-2306-00826.title: In or Out? Fixing ImageNet Out-of-Distribution Detection Evaluation
arxiv-2306-00826.creator: Julian Bitterwolf, Maximilian Müller, Matthias Hein
arxiv-2306-00826.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Julian Bitterwolf, Maximilian Müller, Matthias Hein. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is the problem of identifying inputs which are unrelated to the in-distribution task. The OOD detection performance when the in-distribution (ID) is ImageNet-1K is commonly being tested on a small range of test OOD datasets.

arxiv-2309-00502.title: How heat propagates in liquid 3 He
arxiv-2309-00502.creator: Kamran Behnia, Kostya Trachenko
arxiv-2309-00502.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kamran Behnia, Kostya Trachenko. In Landau’s Fermi liquid picture, transport is governed by scattering between quasi-particles. The normal liquid 3 He conforms to this picture but only at very low temperature. Here, we show that the deviation from the standard behavior is concomitant with the fermion-fermion scattering time falling below the Planckian time, ℏ k B ​ T \frac{\hbar}{k_{\rm B}T} and the thermal diffusivity of this quantum liquid is bounded by a minimum set by fundamental physical constants and observed in classical liquids.

arxiv-2409-14184.title: Content-aware Tile Generation using Exterior Boundary Inpainting CCS: Computing methodologies Texturing CCS: Computing methodologies Appearance and texture representations
arxiv-2409-14184.creator: Sam Sartor, Pieter Peers
arxiv-2409-14184.description: Abstract . We present a novel and flexible learning-based method for generating tileable image sets. Our method goes beyond simple self-tiling, supporting sets of mutually tileable images that exhibit a high degree of diversity. To promote diversity we decouple structure from content by foregoing explicit copying of patches from an exemplar image.

arxiv-2505-24025.title: DINO-R1 : Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in Vision Foundation Models
arxiv-2505-24025.creator: Chenbin Pan, Wenbin He, Zhengzhong Tu, Liu Ren
arxiv-2505-24025.description: Abstract The recent explosive interest in the reasoning capabilities of large language models, such as DeepSeek-R1, has demonstrated remarkable success through reinforcement learning-based fine-tuning frameworks, exemplified by methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, such reasoning abilities remain underexplored and notably absent in vision foundation models, including representation models like the DINO series.

pmc-10559318.title: 10 Hz repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) may improve cognitive function: An exploratory study of schizophrenia patients with auditory hallucinations
pmc-10559318.creator: Jiankai Mao, Kaili Fan, Yaoyao Zhang, Na Wen, Xinyu Fang, Xiangming Ye, Yi Chen
pmc-10559318.description: ObjectivesCognitive impairment in schizophrenia patients with auditory hallucinations is more prominent compared to those without. Our study aimed to investigate the cognitive improvement effects of 10 Hz repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) in schizophrenia with auditory hallucinations.

pmc-11354934.title: Pyroptosis in Skeleton Diseases: A Potential Therapeutic Target Based on Inflammatory Cell Death
pmc-11354934.creator: Qian Wu, Jiacheng Du, Eun Ju Bae, Yunjung Choi, Inbo Han
pmc-11354934.description: Skeletal disorders, including fractures, osteoporosis, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and spinal degenerative conditions, along with associated spinal cord injuries, significantly impair daily life and impose a substantial burden. Many of these conditions are notably linked to inflammation, with some classified as inflammatory diseases.

pmc-11506508.title: Synthetic and Natural Inhibitors of Mortalin for Cancer Therapy
pmc-11506508.creator: Shruti Kaushal, Samriddhi Gupta, Seyad Shefrin, Dhvani Sandip Vora, Sunil C Kaul, Durai Sundar, Renu Wadhwa, Jaspreet Kaur Dhanjal, Konstantinos Dimas
pmc-11506508.description: Simple SummaryMortalin is a heat shock protein 70 stress chaperone family member with variable subcellular localization in normal and cancer cells. It is an essential protein with multiple functions that support and promote proliferation, endorsed by its enriched expression in various cancers.

pmc-12428614.title: Cardiac Development, Cellular Composition and Function: From Regulatory Mechanisms to Applications
pmc-12428614.creator: Huan-Yu Zhao, Jie-Bing Jiang, Shu-Na Wang, Chao-Yu Miao
pmc-12428614.description: Cardiogenesis and heart cell composition and function constitute fundamental areas of cardiovascular medicine research, and exploring their underlying mechanisms is closely tied to the goals of precision medicine. This review comprehensively examines the composition and functions of the heart from embryonic organogenesis to maturity, and highlights the main breakthroughs of treatment strategies associated with these processes.

pmc-12494914.title: Spondias pinnata mediated silver nanoparticles with antibiofilm and catalytic potential
pmc-12494914.creator: Bijoy Krishna Das, Manash Chandra Das, Sourav Ghosh, Rajesh Debnath, Antony Gomes, Utpal Chandra De
pmc-12494914.description: In the quest for advancing bio-conjugated metal nanoparticle synthesis as a promising avenue in biochemistry, this study emphasizes the optimized fabrication of silver nanoparticles mediated by Spondias pinnata. The synthesized silver nanoparticles (SP-AgNPs) exhibited remarkable colloidal stability for 6–7 months at ambient temperature (25 ± 4 °C) supported by a highly negative zeta potential of -37 mV.

pmc-12661307.title: Synthetic cells by the numbers
pmc-12661307.creator: Chana G Sokolik, Maya Bar-Dolev, Ron Milo, Katarzyna P Adamala, Michael Levy
pmc-12661307.description: SummaryCan we build a living cell from non-living molecular components? This foundational question drives the field of synthetic cell engineering, having already reconstituted key cellular processes within synthetic environments, and now advancing toward their integration into systems of increasing complexity.

pmc-12748617.title: Predictors of longitudinal viral load suppression among adults receiving first line antiretroviral therapy in Central Ethiopia

pmc-12748617.description: HIV/AIDS continues to be a major global public health issue and a significant cause of death. While the WHO advocates for viral load testing as the primary approach to monitor treatment and detect antiretroviral therapy (ART) failure, the factors affecting viral load trends are frequently neglected.

Introduction Non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) refers to an expanding array of techniques designed to modulate neural activity in a non-invasive manner (e.g., without the need for surgical intervention or implanted devices).

pmc-13110831.title: A Clinical Algorithm for Full‐Mouth Rehabilitation in Patients With Generalized Severe Tooth Wear: A Case Report

pmc-13110831.description: ObjectivesTo present a structured decision‐making approach to full‐mouth rehabilitation in patients with generalized severe tooth wear, using functional risk classification (Green, Yellow, Red) and the Smile Design and Space (SDS) Concept for vertical dimension planning.Material and MethodsA 65‐year‐old male presented with generalized erosion and attrition, affecting esthetics and speech. A structured diagnostic protocol began with symptom‐based questionnaires and clinical examination.

pmc-13156503.title: Efficacy, pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, safety, and immunogenicity of Bmab 1000 vs reference denosumab: 78-wk results from a randomized, double-blind, multicenter, parallel-arm Phase 3 trial (DEVOTE) in women with postmenopausal osteoporosis
pmc-13156503.creator: Richard Eastell, Eric Orwoll, Felicia Cosman, Rafal Plebanski, Kuldeep Kumar, Ashwani Marwah, Sarika S Deodhar, Elena Wolff-Holz, Subramanian Loganathan
pmc-13156503.description: This randomized, double-blind, multicenter Phase 3 trial evaluated the efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamics (PD), pharmacokinetics (PK), and immunogenicity of Bmab 1000 vs reference denosumab in 479 women with postmenopausal osteoporosis. Participants (mean age 66.6 yr; lumbar spine T-score ≤−2.5 to ≥−4.0) were randomized 1:1 to receive 60 mg Bmab 1000 (n = 238) or reference denosumab (n = 241) subcutaneously.

pmc-13398679.creator: Youssra Salhi, Stavros Makrodimitris, Sandra van Wilpe, Iris te Paske, Vanja de Weerd, Corine M Beaufort, Hans M Westgeest, Jens Voortman, Maureen J B Aarts, Maud Rijnders, Astrid A M van der Veldt, Ronald de Wit, Niven Mehra, Saskia M Wilting, Debbie G J Robbrecht
pmc-13398679.description: Accurate prediction of lack of benefit from pembrolizumab in patients with metastatic urothelial cancer (mUC) is an unmet need. We investigated the dynamics of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) load, estimated using the modified fast aneuploidy screening test‐sequencing system (mFast‐SeqS), as a potential biomarker for early on‐treatment identification of treatment response.

pmc-13432528.title: Unveiling the Microvasculature: The Index of Microcirculatory Resistance and Its Expanding Role in Cardiovascular Care
pmc-13432528.creator: Joanna Sohn, Matthew A. Soderstrom, Ariana Ramirez, John‐Henry Dean, Raj Shah, Debanshu Roy, Kenneth Stone, Ariel Vinas, Bryan Ramsey, Charles Lin, Robert Chilton
pmc-13432528.description: Index of microcirculatory resistance (IMR) is a cutting‐edge, wire‐based tool that advances the capability assessment of coronary microvascular function. By utilizing distal coronary pressure and mean transit time under maximal hyperemia, IMR delivers consistent, reproducible insights into the microvasculature's dynamic health.

pmc-13625966.title: Seamless QM/MM Simulations via a GROMACS-CP2K Interface
pmc-13625966.creator: Dmitry Morozov, Christian Blau, Ole Schütt, Vladimir Mironov, Arno Proeme, Holly Judge, Thomas D. Kühne, Berk Hess, Gerrit Groenhof
